Written by hand.
A module that generates part of its own API and carries no go.mod, the way
golang.org/x/text did before it had one. The zip holds only the source.

The opt-in line lives in a module's own go.mod. This module has none, so it
has nowhere to write one.

-- .mod --
module example.com/generatednomod
-- .info --
{"Version": "v1.0.0"}
-- gen/main.go --
package main

import (
	"flag"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	out := flag.String("out", "", "file to write")
	flag.Parse()
	body := "package lang\n\nfunc Name() string { return \"generated\" }\n"
	if err := os.WriteFile(*out, []byte(body), 0o666); err != nil {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
-- lang/lang.go --
//go:generate go run example.com/generatednomod/gen -out lang.gen.go

// Package lang declares nothing itself: Name is the generator's to write.
package lang
